transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hi. Thank you. Um... I came in because I just can't stop feeling like I'm a disappointment. And a danger, honestly. I had this one near-miss at work—I'm a nurse—and it just... it feels like it proves I'm not meant to do this job. Lately I just keep having this feeling that everyone would be better off without me.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah, I have. Um... most days I just wake up with this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. And even when I'm at the clinic trying to act normal... like, I'll be smiling at my patients in Spanish and just trying to do my job, but honestly, I feel like I'm just barely holding myself together. So, yeah, it's pretty much all the time lately.
Have you ever had a time in the past when you felt this depressed or hopeless?

No, not really. Um... I mean, I've been stressed before, especially getting through school and everything, but... I've never felt like this. I've never had this kind of heavy, hopeless feeling where I just can't shake it. So, yeah, this is the first time it's been this bad.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt the opposite—unusually energetic, elated, or wired, needing much less sleep than normal?

No, I don't think so. I've never felt like that. I mean, there are times I've had to stay up late to study or work, but I always felt tired the next day. I've never had a time where I just didn't need sleep or felt wired like that.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy doing?

Yeah, I have. Um... I used to do a lot of things to clear my head after class and work. I liked jogging, knitting, cooking, or even just reading. But lately... I just don't care about any of it. I come home, and I just sit on my bed, still in my scrubs, and I just can't make myself do anything. The interest just isn't there anymore.
How has your sleep been lately?

It really hasn't been good. Um... at night, I just lie there in bed and my brain won't shut off. I keep replaying all the patient charts and medication calculations from work. And then... when I finally do manage to fall asleep, I end up waking up way before my alarm even goes off. I just wake up already feeling completely exhausted, and I'm usually scared that I missed something important on my shift.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?

Yeah, I have. Um... I mostly just forget to eat until late in the day. And even then, I usually just have to force down some crackers or drink some coffee. I haven't been trying to lose weight or anything, but my work pants have definitely been getting loose on me lately.
